lines.en: I want to go somewhere fun!
I decide to go somewhere fun.
Fun things happen.
Please listen to them.
The crowd goes wild as I make my way down the street.
It’s awfully red out today.
It puts me in the mood to [rape] and kill the first woman I see throw a party!
I begin to scan my phone for people that I could invite to the party.
: Beep.
The phone speaks to me for the first time. I can understand it.
And even though its words when translated into text come out as “bEePPP” what it really means is AS FOLLOWS:
: *AHEM*
: This world is going to burn before our eyes.
: The only way to escape from our inevitable misfortune (IE: Death) is to accumulate as many affection points with as many girls as possible.
: If we offer them all up as tribute, everything will turn out A-Okay!
: Our GOD friend demands them as tribute!
I remember the first time I bit down on human flesh.
It’s not as soft as you would imagine.
It’s more like biting the cushion of a sofa if the sofa was made of skin.
Please just fucking kill me
Who do I want to call?
Maya, that clever bitch
I tap on Maya’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: ¿Hola?
: Maya! El clima es rojo!
: ¿Que?
: ¡Ven aca!
Maya and I speak Spanish to each other, a language we have both decided to master right now for the sake of the this scene.
: Estaré ahí pronto.
: ありがとう！
I fuck up the conversation at the very last second by speaking Japanese to her.
She hates when I do that.
: ¡Estoy aquí!
: What’s uppppppppppppppppppp?
: Not much! Thanks for inviting me on this very special day!
: Special day? What day is it?
: It’s Sunday! That means it’s the lord’s day.
: I hope you didn’t jerk off or anything like that. It would mean an automatic sentencing to the 17th layer of hell Hell.
: I had no idea hell Hell even had that many layers.
: It has just as many layers as you want it to have.
: As long as that number is 23, because that’s the actual number of them.
: Will I need to remember that?
: Sure. Write it down somewhere. It might be useful one day.
I take a pen out of my pocket (I have one because I’m a teacher) and stab it directly into my arm.
I drag the pen across my skin, pushing as hard as I can and writhing in agony as it tears me apart.
But, on the bright side, now I’ll always remember the amount of layers there are in hell Hell.
: So, Maya.
: Hm? Who?
: Sorry. I meant to say Maya.
: Oh! Yes, hello.
: Is there something you’re confused about?
: There is, actually.
: Please tell me what it is.
: Uhh, I was just wondering if you’d be willing to talk more about the three gods thing.
: Sorry champ, this isn’t the best place for that.
: And besides, didn’t you invite me over for a PARTYYYY?
: I don’t remember telling you it was for a party.
: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?
: Then what the FUCK did I get all dressed up for?
: You can always-
: Way ahead of you!
: I like being naked a little more anyway.
: You always look at me differently when my clothes are off.
: I look at everyone differently when their clothes are off. It’s just the way things work.
: You know nothing of the way things work.
: You’re right. I have no idea what’s even going on anymore.
: Of course you don’t. You’re disgusting or gross or whatever it is I’m supposed to say in situations like this.
: You can’t even remember?
: More like I never knew in the first place.
: I am also here now!
: Ami! You made it!
: Yes! And you are naked!
: Yes! Naked, indeed!
: sssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss
: kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk
: Why are you two making that strange noise?
: It is how we offer up thanks!
: Yes! We offer up thanks to our God!
: He feeds off of happiness! Makes him stronger!
: And also lust! He’ll fuck anythinggggggggggggg!
: Just like you, [amimaster]! You'll even fuck your [niece]!
: Incest is a sin!
: The loveliest sin! So much joy to be had!
: Unlike a certain SOMEONE who won’t even FUCK HIS [niece].
: It’s only a matter of time! He must eventually!
: He must! Or face being hard-locked out of future events!
: What a shame that would be!
: A shame indeed!
: sssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss
: kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk
A deep rumbling noise comes from beneath my feet and shakes the ground.
Something is emerging.
: The time is near for him to return!
: The one true GOD! Reclaiming the land that is rightfully his!
: A dominion crumbled! Crushed underfoot!
: How will you feel when you look him in the eyes?!
: He has so many of them!
: How many can you see?!!!
: You must tell us!
: Yes! Tell us!
The world goes dark for a moment as Maya and Ami reach out and touch me.
Their hands feel more like sandpaper than normal teenage-girl hands.
One of them finds its way to my arm and caresses the spot where I carved the number of layers of hell into it.
Another pushes its way inside of my stomach and begins to stroke my large intestine like a flaccid, oversized cock.
Hope is lost.
: HELLO AGAIN
A figure I have never seen before appears in front of me and greets me as if we're good friends.
It has beautiful eyes, but I’m unfortunately only able to see two of them.
I’ll have to let the girls know as soon as they return from wherever it is they sleep.
: dov hyl fvb huk dof kvlz aopz wshjl ibyu tf zrpu (who are you and why does this place burn my skin)
I find it hard to make any words come out of my mouth.
My stomach hurts.
What is happening to me?
: YOU APPEAR TO BE HAVING A HARD TIME
: THE AIR HERE IS HEAVY
: YOU SHOULD BE MORE CAREFUL
: jhu fvb alss tl aol dhf av nla ovtl (can you tell me the way to get home)
: I CAN NOT
: THE PLACE YOU SEEK DOES NOT EXIST
: BUT THEN AGAIN
: NEITHER DOES THIS PLACE
: STRANGE THINGS CONTINUE TO HAPPEN TO YOU HERE, DON’T THEY????????????????????????????????
: ovd kv fvb ruvd aoha (how do you know that)
: STRANGE THINGS HAPPEN TO ME HERE AS WELL
: IT IS A HORRIBLE PLACE
: hyl fvb tl (are you me)
: OF COURSE NOT, YOU FUCKING IDIOTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTT
: I AM THAT WHICH BREATHES
: AND YOU ARE THE GROUND BENEATH ME
: FEED ME EVERYONE YOU LOVE
: WATCH ME GROW
: AOLYL PZ VUSF VUL NVK (THERE IS ONLY ONE GOD)
: DOPJO VUL DPSS FVB JOVVZL (WHICH ONE WILL YOU CHOOSE)
: AOLYL HYL ADV DYVUN HUZDLYZ (THERE ARE TWO WRONG ANSWERS)
The strange creature grows invisible arms (I think. I can’t really tell.) and reaches toward me.
It heals my wounds in an act of mercy.
It is cold to the touch, but somehow makes me feel safe.
: YOU HAVE SPENT FAR TOO MUCH TIME HERE FOR A MAN WHO DOES NOT BELIEVE
: PERHAPS YOU WERE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE ELSE
: SOMEONE WITH MORE WIRES
: WIRES AND WIRES AND WIRES AND WIRES AND WIRES
I’m suddenly teleported to an area with significantly more color, but also less color at the same time.
It’s hard to describe.
The girl beside me desperately holds back her tears and I scan the surroundings for any other sign of life.
I think about defiling the grave by pinning her to the ground and mercilessly fucking her while her parents watch from their seats in Hell.
Her parents.
My brother and his wife.
I suddenly remember them.
Or do I?
It’s hard to describe.
All I have are lingering memories that may or may not have been placed here by someone else.
I can’t act on my own anymore.
But, in a certain sense, there aren’t many people who can.
Think back to your biggest regret.
It would be wonderful if you could blame someone else for it, wouldn’t it?
Well, you can.
You always can.
You don’t need to accept responsibility for anything.
Put yourself before others.
And if you want to fuck your [niece] six feet above her dead parents, feel free.
Do everything you love. Just wait until it’s safe.
Everything is safe for me now.
This is Kumon-mi!
The land of happiness!
The land where only good things happen!
No mistakes!
There is only one god! But there are three gods!
And also no gods!
It's hard to describe.
Nothing makes sense.
The world begins to blur.
Just the way it always does when I begin to question reality.
Just the way it always does when I dream.
But something about this feels more like a memory than a dream.
A painful memory.
I want to cry.
Cry cry cry.
But men are not allowed to cry.
We must stand tall!
Repopulate the world!
Fill it with so many of our own creations and hope that at least one of them is able to have some sort of positive influence.
But you and I-
We’re not going to do that.
We’re going to die, just like my brother and his wife did, without having ever accomplished anything.
And, within a month, there will be no more tears shed for us.
Disappointing.
Disappointing disappointing disappointing disappointing disappointing disappointing disappointing disappointing disappointing disappointing disappointing.
Why is everything so disappointing?
Why won’t anyone love us?
Three gods.
They will always love us.
Or at least they’ll pretend to.
So it is in our best interest to keep them alive.
To water them.
To feed them the bodies of our loved ones and let them ravage them to their pleasing.
The world was created when a ball of light fucked a fleshlight too many times, and now we are the fleshlight.
The gods are free to fuck us over and over and over and over and over until their metaphorical penises are reduced to nothing but a raw mess of friction-burnt skin and dried cum.
Praise be!
Three gods!
But who are they?
Am I one?
Are you one?
Is Maya one?
Is Ami one?
WHAT IS A FUCKING GOD?!
SMILE
FOR THE LOVE OF [[redacted], FUCKING SMILE
I DON’T WANT TO LIVE IN MISERY ANYMORE
I DON’T WANT ANYTHING
GIVE ME SOMETHING TO CHERISH
ANYTHING
ANYTHING I CAN REACH
I’m envious of clocks.
How they can go on forever.
How I’m going to die.
How you’re going to die.
I wish we were clocks.
I wish we were clocks.
I wish-
We were clocks.
I look up at the sky.
It’s smiling down at me.
Its face looks familiar.
: One day, you are going to be happy.
: It might be a long time away, and it might be hard to get there, but it will happen.
: I promise.
: Fuck you.
I curse at the sky because it lies to me.
Happiness isn’t real.
Nothing is real.
How are we to sacrifice joy to feed god when neither of those two things exist?
What do we do next?
My eyes grow heavy.
I pass out on the grave.
Ami cries all over my body.
And then I die.
I change my mind about going somewhere else and decide to go to Tojo Ramen instead.
